info.title: Plugboard client API
info.description: OpenAI-compatible gateway API for client keys. Integration guide: docs/api/README.md.

bearer.description: A client key (pb_...) or the instance API_KEY.

reasoning.description: Reasoning text, for models that expose it.
reasoning.title: Reasoning

Billing.description: What the call cost, as recorded against the caller's key.

model.description: Model id that served the call, after fallback.
model.title: Model

price_key.description: Admin keys only: the pricing-grid entry that priced the call.
price_key.title: Price Key

Billing.title: Billing

billing.description: Present when the call was billed to a key.

ChatCompletionChunk.description:
One `data:` event of a streamed completion (SSE).

The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`. A chunk carrying `usage` (and
`cost_usd` when the gateway computed it) always comes before `[DONE]`.
ChatCompletionChunk.title: ChatCompletionChunk

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI ``POST /v1/chat/completions`` body, plus two Plugboard fields.

model.description: `provider:model` (see GET /v1/models), or a bare model id, which is routed to the first active provider that serves it.
model.title: Model

temperature.description: Removed before forwarding for models that reject sampling parameters (Claude Opus 4.7 and later, Sonnet 5+, Haiku 5+).
temperature.title: Temperature

max_tokens.description: Renamed to max_completion_tokens for OpenAI o-series models.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

cache.description: Plugboard: false bypasses the response cache for this call.
cache.title: Cache

session_id.description: Plugboard: the gateway keeps the conversation and prepends it, so only the new turn is sent. Same as the X-LLM-Session-ID header.
session_id.title: Session Id

ChatCompletionRequest.title: ChatCompletionRequest

content.description: Text, or OpenAI content parts (text, image_url).
content.title: Content

ClientInfo.description:
Who the key belongs to, its limits and this month's spend.

Every field but `client_id` is absent for an unauthenticated call.

remaining_usd.description: null when the key has no monthly limit.
remaining_usd.title: Remaining Usd

ClientInfo.title: ClientInfo

key_display.description: Prefix of the key followed by ***.
key_display.title: Key Display

ErrorResponse.description:
FastAPI's error body. Upstream timeouts (503) add `retry_after` and a
Retry-After header; a failing CLI provider (502) adds its exit details.
ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse

auth_disabled.description: Present (true) when client auth is off.
auth_disabled.title: Auth Disabled

id.description: Pass it as `model` to the chat endpoint.
id.title: Id

connected.description: false when the last probe could not reach it.
connected.title: Connected

account_compatible.description: Whether the calling key may use this model.
account_compatible.title: Account Compatible

model_key.description: Profile entry the model id matched.
model_key.title: Model Key

ModelProfile.description: Static knowledge about a model: capabilities, benchmarks, cost tier.
ModelProfile.title: ModelProfile
